Documents Unsealed Regarding Search of Rep. Ilhan Omar's Home

Documents unsealed by a judge reveal details about a search of U.S. Representative Ilhan Omar's Washington D.C. home. The search warrant documents indicate the investigation has a decades-long scope. Records also show a judge demanded safeguards before the search could proceed. The Department of Justice stated that the House's top lawyer "refused to be involved" ahead of the search.
